name: Rutland Railroad
author: FUSE
description: Rutland Railroad terrain package generated from the active map profile.

map.description: The Rutland's Vermont main line: Bellows Falls over Mount Holly summit to Rutland, north through the Otter Creek valley to Burlington, and the Island Line across the Lake Champlain causeways to Alburgh. Terrain export follows a sparse railway corridor approximately ten 500 m tiles wide. The Bennington leg, Chatham branch, and Ogdensburg division are outside the map budget and are clipped by the line bounds.
